LAGOS (PSI 9.3): LASCOPA resolved 528 Ikeja Electric complaints securing ₦26.2m in refunds while LASWARCO cracked down on unauthorized borehole drilling.
PLATEAU (PSI 9.2): Opened 11th Jos Trade Fair, constituted China Trade Park committee, approved 1,800-youth BPO hub, and treated 8,000+ patients with ICZ Germany.
ENUGU (PSI 9.1): Signed landmark BPO agreement with Humatrix Limited for 100,000 jobs under Enugu Talent City Initiative to expand GDP to $30bn.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.8): Delivered 500kVA transformer to Ekong Eta[cite: 2], launched BIASE BOLD digital skills for 100 youths, opened 2027 Budget Retreat, and partnered with NCDC[cite: 2].
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.7): EXCO approved ₦38.16bn in contracts including ₦9.45bn hospital quarters, 210 electric tricycles, and ₦15.12bn Kiri-Shelleng road overlay[cite: 1].
EDO (PSI 8.6): Unveiled 'Made-in-Edo' circular e-platform, held Permanent Secretaries retreat, and secured 5th rank in SBM Health Index.
DELTA (PSI 8.4): Swore in Head of Service Dr. Babigha-Ehimen, approved 12 Perm Sec duplexes, and dispatched inspectors to Uzere gas sites.
OYO (PSI 8.3): Commissioned CapitalSage Holdings HQ in Ibadan and completed the 8.43km Fasola Farm Settlement Road under RAAMP.
KADUNA (PSI 8.2): KDSPHCB issued strict Oct 31 CBT recruitment directives while Deputy Gov. Balarabe swore in 23 commissioners and advisers.
ABIA (PSI 8.0): ABSOA launched 'Future Ready' youth anti-drug drive in Isuikwuato, warning illicit drug dealers and compromised NDLEA officers.
NIGER (PSI 7.9): Pension Board test-ran the digital NPAS portal to automate CPS records and benefit verification for retirees.
GOMBE (PSI 7.8): Gov. Inuwa Yahaya visited Kumo over fatal truck crash, released ₦20m to bereaved families, and ordered free medical treatment.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.8): Ministry of Health launched a 5-day AOP validation workshop in Kaduna with WHO and UNICEF under state health emergency framework.
NASARAWA (PSI 7.7): Gov. Sule swore in 5 Special Advisers, inaugurated Isaac Ali Kigbu to NSUK Council, and chaired Executive Council meeting.
RIVERS (PSI 7.5): Gov. Fubara opened Traditional Rulers Council meeting, charging royal fathers to maintain political neutrality ahead of 2027.
TARABA (PSI 7.3): Gov. Kefas appealed to striking TSU lecturers to resume exams, setting up a state committee to review salary structures.
OSUN (PSI 7.1): Taskforce on Environmental Sanitation announced immediate recruitment of ad-hoc road sweepers across 12 designated urban zones.
